abstract: PURPOSE OF INVESTIGATION: A retrospective analysis of 55 cases of malignant germ cell tumors in a 20-year period was done to evaluate the impact of conservative surgery and adjuvant treatment on survival and fertility. METHODS: Fifty-five cases of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (MOGCTs) were studied. Mean age was 22 years. Dysgerminoma was the most common histotype (45%). RESULTS: Thirty-nine patients (71%) presented with FIGO surgical Stage I disease. Fertility-sparing surgery was performed in 39 (71%) women. Postoperative systemic chemotherapy was administered to 40 women (73%), 27 (68%) had received conservative treatment. One woman developed renal failure after the first cycle of chemotherapy and died a few days thereafter and there was one case of bleomycin-induced death due to pulmonary fibrosis. There were eight (14.5%) clinical recurrences. Overall survival rate for relapsing women was 75% (6/8). The recurrence rate for women treated conservatively was 15%, and it was 13% for those treated radically. With a median follow-up of 129 months the overall survival rate for the entire study-population was 90.9%. Eleven pregnancies occurred in 36 women treated with fertility-sparing surgery who were of child-bearing age. CONCLUSION: The management of MOGCTs with fertility-sparing surgery is a safe, practicable treatment option. The majority of these patients can retain normal ovarian function and reproductive potential after chemotherapy treatment.
abstract_ja: 目的：悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍55例について、保存的手術と補助療法が生存と妊孕性に与える影響を評価するため、後方視的解析を行った。対象：平均年齢22歳の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍55例を対象とした。ディスジャーミノーマが最も多く(45%)、組織型の中で最多であった。結果：39例(71%)がFIGO病期Iの疾患で受診した。39例(71%)に妊孕性温存手術が施行された。40例(73%)に術後全身化学療法が施行され、そのうち27例(68%)が保存的治療を受けていた。化学療法後の第1サイクルで腎不全を来して数日後に死亡した1例と、ブレオマイシンによる肺線維症で死亡した1例があった。再発は8例(14.5%)であった。再発女性の全生存期間(全生存率)は75%(6/8)であった。保存的治療を受けた女性の再発率は15%、根治的治療を受けた女性では13%であった。中央値129か月の追跡期間で、全研究集団の全生存期間(全生存率)は90.9%であった。妊娠可能年齢で妊孕性温存手術を受けた36例のうち11例が妊娠した。結論：妊孕性温存手術による悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理は安全で実施可能な治療選択肢である。大多数の患者では、化学療法後も正常な卵巣機能と生殖能力を維持できる。
